confirmedFindings.title: Concurrent Trunk Allocation Check-Then-Act Race Condition
confirmedFindings.body: Checking activeChannels < maxChannels without atomic CAS or mutex synchronization allows parallel call setup requests to interleave, leasing channels beyond the carrier's contracted hard limit and triggering 503 Service Unavailable trunk errors.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) or a mutex around channel lease increments.
